mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Public Library. Tonight's moon phase is a Waning Gibbous, and if you are a night owl, you can see the space station pass over at 4:17 AM as it travels from the Middleton area near Verona High School toward Fitchburg and Madison. The overnight low will be 71 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Senior Center announced they are updating their floors starting September 1, which means limited access to programs and a closure on Labor Day. Also, public works crews are currently addressing a water main break near 212 Todd Street, so please use caution in that area.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a great selection of fun, including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and the return of the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.
In our weekly police recap, on August 27, a traffic stop regarding a suspended registration led to the arrest of a passenger who had multiple outstanding warrants.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle Dove. Culver's is currently open and will be serving this treat until they close at 10 PM tonight.
